# JurisTech Solutions - Complete Platform Documentation
## Version 10.5.1 | Updated: September 2026
## URL: https://www.juristech.solutions

# ABOUT
JurisTech Solutions is the leading sovereign AI legal technology platform for the MENA region and global markets. Founded by Dr. Mohammad Mustafa (AI Risk Architect), the platform serves enterprises, law firms, government entities, and individual business owners across 50+ countries.

Mission: Democratize access to high-quality legal services through AI automation while maintaining sovereign data control and multi-jurisdictional compliance.

# CORE PLATFORM CAPABILITIES

## 1. AI Contract Analysis
URL: /contracts
Description: Upload any contract (PDF, Word, or paste text) for instant AI analysis. The engine identifies:
- Risky clauses and unfair terms
- Unlimited liability provisions
- Penalty clauses exceeding legal limits
- Missing mandatory clauses
- Jurisdiction mismatches
- Force majeure gaps
Output: Detailed report with risk score (0-100), highlighted clauses, and suggested redlines in Arabic and English.

## 2. Legal Risk Radar
URL: /risk
Description: Comprehensive legal risk scoring system that analyzes contracts against jurisdiction-specific regulations. Provides:
- Overall risk score (0-100, color-coded)
- Breakdown by risk category (Financial, Operational, IP, Regulatory)
- Severity classification (Critical, High, Medium, Low)
- Actionable remediation suggestions
- Automated risk report generation (PDF/Word)

## 3. Smart Contract Templates
URL: /templates
Description: 200+ professionally crafted, legally vetted contract templates including:
- Employment agreements (Saudi Arabia, UAE, Egypt, international)
- Service agreements and SLAs
- Partnership and joint venture agreements
- Non-disclosure agreements (NDAs)
- Sales and distribution contracts
- Real estate contracts
- Franchise agreements
- Technology and software licenses

## 4. Power of Attorney (POA) Library
URL: /poa-library
Description: Comprehensive collection of Power of Attorney templates for GCC and international markets. Covers general POA, specific POA, real estate POA, business management POA, with notarization guidance.

## 5. Contract Negotiation Assistant
URL: /negotiation
Description: AI-powered negotiation support featuring:
- Clause-by-clause negotiation tracking
- Counter-proposal generation
- Integrated e-signature capabilities
- Version control and audit trail
- Multi-party collaboration

## 6. Deal Shield
URL: /deal-shield
Description: Comprehensive transaction protection and due diligence tool. Analyzes deal terms, identifies deal-breakers, provides structured due diligence checklist, and generates risk assessment reports.

## 7. Company Formation
URL: /company-formation
Description: End-to-end business registration assistance for:
- UAE (mainland, DIFC, ADGM, free zones)
- Saudi Arabia (limited liability, joint stock)
- Egypt (SAE, SPC, branches)
- UK and European entities
- Delaware and US LLCs
Includes document preparation, regulatory guidance, and timeline tracking.

## 8. Encrypted Document Vault
URL: /vault
Description: Bank-grade AES-256 encrypted document storage with:
- End-to-end encryption (client-side)
- Access control and permissions
- Version history
- Secure sharing with audit trail
- GDPR-compliant data handling

## 9. AI Legal Advisor
URL: /ai-advisor
Description: 24/7 AI legal consultation chatbot trained on legal databases from 15+ jurisdictions. Answers questions about contract law, company formation, regulatory compliance, and dispute resolution in Arabic and English.

## 10. Enterprise Audit
URL: /enterprise-audit
Description: Comprehensive legal and compliance audit for enterprises. Reviews existing contracts, identifies compliance gaps, generates executive board reports, and tracks remediation progress.

## 11. Contract Repository
URL: /repository
Description: Centralized contract management system with:
- Full-text search across all contracts
- Metadata tagging and categorization
- Expiration alerts and renewal reminders
- Status tracking (draft, review, signed, expired)
- Analytics and reporting dashboard

## 12. B2B Proposals
URL: /b2b-proposals
Description: AI-powered B2B proposal generation and management system. Creates professional, personalized proposals for enterprise clients with pricing, scope of work, and terms.

# JURISDICTIONS & LEGAL FRAMEWORKS

## GCC & MENA
- Saudi Arabia: Civil Transactions Law (1443H), Companies Law, Sharia principles
- UAE: Federal Civil Code, DIFC Law, ADGM Regulations, Free Zone laws
- Egypt: Civil Code (Law 131/1948), Commercial Law
- Kuwait: Civil Code, Commercial Law No. 68/1980
- Qatar: Civil Code No. 22/2004, Commercial Companies Law
- Bahrain: Civil Code, Commercial Companies Law
- Oman: Civil Transactions Law, Commercial Law
- Jordan: Civil Law No. 43/1976

## International
- USA: Uniform Commercial Code (UCC), Delaware General Corporation Law
- UK: Companies Act 2006, English Contract Law
- EU: GDPR, Brussels Regulation, Rome I and II
- International: UNCITRAL Model Law, ICC Rules, CISG

# SECURITY & COMPLIANCE
- AES-256 client-side encryption
- Two-Factor Authentication (2FA/TOTP)
- Row-Level Security (RLS) in database

- Regular penetration testing
